Merge branch 'jhan-vnnik-2-amx-5047' into jhan-vnnik-3-shared-save-5047

3.summary: PR 4958 (the 16-token block save of VNNI-packed keys, shared with the idle main helpers) re-expressed on PR 5047's structure. One page::set_k_block serves every slot and converts rows inside the page, so model.hpp keeps one layout fact (page::k_store_scatters, the sharing decision) and no layout code. store_k_block is one loop over the runs next_k_run finds in a span of items, with one set_k_block call per run and KV head. The shared store is a phase of batch::k_store_barrier (tron::barrier) with greedy_range claims. The hand-written counters, the _mm_pause spins, the 120 s join abort and the 128-worker cap are gone. The Note is [Shared VNNI K store].
pr_body_facts: model.hpp, self_attention.hpp and full.hpp hold no K-layout code (every section-4 pattern counts 0 on code lines); model.hpp keeps page::k_store_scatters and page::k_block_tokens only.

page::set_k_block takes the rows of up to 16 tokens of one block as typed row views (std::array<Row, 16>, an absent lane = an invalid view); a VNNI slot scatters one valid row with store_row and transposes two or more with store_block; a row-major slot stores each valid row in place; non-bf16 rows are converted on the page's stack.
The raw-pointer + __mmask16 page overload is gone; the tensor store_block takes the same typed row views store_row takes.

A shared store is one phase of batch::k_store_barrier, reset in reset_channels with n_main_workers (the generated run() resets before it launches the helpers); main cuts units, opens the phase, stores, calls done and waits for all; a helper waits, stores and calls done; every thread claims units with greedy_range.

Named behaviour exceptions: save_k call counts that differ now wait (TRON_LATCH_WATCHDOG logs the latch states) instead of aborting after 120 s; the 128-worker cap on sharing is gone; a participant index at or above the reset count fails a TRON_ASSERT inside the barrier.

store_k_block(slot, ks, std::span<const token_job_id> items): the batch pointer with two positions is gone; the save_k case of t_llama_unit calls reset_channels(0, 3), drives one phase with three threads and checks the bytes before it joins the helpers.
residual_risks: The run-time behaviour of the barrier phase (the pairing of a helper's W-th wait with the W-th phase, no hang when a helper claims nothing) is proved only by the 3bda gate; the syntax matrix compiles it.
Stored-byte identity (the row-major branch, store_row vs store_block, the non-bf16 conversion) is checked at run time only: the save_k case of t_llama_unit and t_k_vnni_layout on 3bda.

PR 4958's time-to-first-token table was measured at 80bce9a08d; nothing is measured at this head. Of the 30 predicted objections, 3 are reduced rather than removed (two is_main branches remain, the function name store_k_block and the parameter c stay, the tensor header keeps FULL_BLOCK_0XFFFF) and 1 is kept by design (two run definitions: the unit cut and the run scan).

4.summary: PR 4959 (the row-major tail block: rows saved below a whole block stay row-major and convert to the VNNI layout at the end of the pass that completes the block) re-expressed on PR 5047's structure. The dense-page gate lives inside page::try_score_k_amx (it declines a VNNI slot unless its four blocks are converted) and the tail scoring inside page::score_k (converted blocks to k_vnni::qk_group, row-major blocks to the dotter through one score_rows lambda). note_k_row_saved answers a page-owned k_pending_block record and k_block_to_vnni converts from it. save_k records rows inside its existing mark loop (skipped under hardware attention). The page copy plans its bits once per slot (k_plan_copy, copy_k_rows). The per-row operations of a row-major block are in namespace detail. The staging pointer path (k_staging_row / k_row_if_row_major) is dropped: PR 5047's k_head_fn copies every K row. Tests reach K only through page operations (test::record_k_row_and_convert in t/kv_cache_helpers.hpp). README.ci.md documents the kill switch and the rebuild a layout rollback needs.
pr_body_facts: self_attention.hpp, model.hpp and full.hpp hold no K-layout code (every section-4 pattern counts 0 on code lines); model.hpp names page::k_block_tokens only; full.hpp keeps PR 5047's k_head_fn (always get_k_row into caller scratch).

page::try_score_k_amx declines (false, scores and storage untouched) a VNNI slot whose four blocks are not all converted; the caller then scores in software at the cost of the 1 KiB zero fill of the score buffer before the call.

page::score_k splits the live mask by the converted-block bits (private k_vnni_token_mask): converted blocks to k_vnni::qk_group, row-major blocks and row-major slots to the dotter through one score_rows lambda.

page::set_k_block with 16 valid rows stores the block transposed (store_block) and records its 16 row bits and block bit itself; fewer rows go through set_k_row per row (which follows the block's recorded layout); a row-major slot stores per lane in place.

note_k_row_saved returns std::optional<page::k_pending_block> (storage view captured at save time + block index); save_k records inside its mark loop when the operation is not hardware-scored; convert_pending_k_blocks converts at the forward end after the staging drain; pending_k_blocks_ reserved once in resize().

The four read-modify-writes that publish the row and block bits use memory_order_release; the k_rows_saved_ field comment names every reader and what orders it (the store's barrier phase, the forward end, the tree lock). No TSan run checks the argument.

The deb preset flip (ea94e95a4e) and the benchmark rows (e7d06a1267) are PR 4959's own commits below the merge: the diff against 6b081187e1 does not touch CMakePresets.json or config/test-benchmarks.json, so no separate last commit exists.
k_plan_copy keeps the five-value parameter list of the base's own copy_storage_slot and append_v (the file's idiom); it is the one new function with more than four parameters.
4.ben_objections_note: 33 removed, 4 reduced (interface-4959-5: set_k_row still leaves the row bit to save_k by design; record-4959-10 and abstraction-4959-8: the hetero plugin keeps its bool template parameters; abstraction-4959-3: k_block_complete / k_block_converted name the bit tests but no k_layout_state type exists), 1 kept by design (abstraction-4959-7: store_block keeps its lane mask for the bit-for-bit test).
residual_risks: Run-time counts of the dispatch test (one pack and no kernel call for a full page with unrecorded rows under the option; one pack, one QK, one PV with recorded rows) and the run-time behaviour of the page cases of t_k_vnni_layout, the three-thread save_k case and the hetero forward-conversion case are proved only by the 3bda gate; the syntax matrix compiles them.

Performance is unmeasured at this head: PR 4959's FPGA decode rows (+2.5 % TPS at tp2, +12.1 % at tp4 at ea94e95a4e) used the pointer staging path that this head drops; the declined-visit zero fill and the next_k_run scan on row-major slots are unmeasured.
The memory-order change (release instead of acq_rel on the two row-bit read-modify-writes) is argued from the field comment only; no thread-sanitizer or stress run checks it.

bda_summary: complete for all three PRs (bp2 and bp2v at 9a8045836a, bp3 and bp3v at 2c501a9390, bp4 and bp4v at 38ad10f25c: 30 of 30 tests pass, the kill switch skips the 3 AMX checks of t_amx_numerics as expected and passes t_llama_unit). The first gate of the fourth PR failed one test-bound assertion at f7c2ccf6b7, the diagnosis found no numeric defect, and the gate passed at 38ad10f25c
open_items: PR4' first gate (f7c2ccf6b7) failed one assertion of t_llama_unit's page-range case. Diagnosis (eight instrumented builds, one 63-agent code analysis): no numeric defect. The VNNI slot scores a different random K instance than the row-major slot, and the case's emulation bound of 0.01 sat below the bf16 weight truncation of the PV product. Fix 38ad10f25c: 5e-2 under the option, the case's own precedent. For reviewers: a reference that truncates its weights the same way, with a bound near 1e-3, is the alternative.

Three fixes for PR 5047 (recommended in the PR2' body, not posted on PR 5047): the hetero test writes through page::k, which that head removes (its Build Tron job fails), the probe Page::head_size names a member that does not exist (vacuous), and the comments of apply_dense_amx_page, the AMX gate, try_score_k_amx and page_info no longer match the code. PR 5047's author decides.

Performance at the three new heads is unmeasured. PR 4958's time-to-first-token table (80bce9a08d) and PR 4959's FPGA decode rows (+2.5 % TPS at tp2, +12.1 % at tp4 at ea94e95a4e) need re-measurement: PR4' drops the pointer staging path, PR3' replaces the counters with a barrier phase. The cells are listed under Pending measurement in each PR body.

PR3' keeps two run definitions (k_store_cut_units cuts the work units, next_k_run scans the runs inside a unit). One definition for both would change the unit boundaries the save_k case asserts. Reviewers decide.

PR4' keeps the bit arithmetic of the K layout state behind two named tests (k_block_complete, k_block_converted). A k_layout_state type with named operations is the follow-up Ben's record suggests (abstraction-4959-3). Reviewers decide.

PR4' changes the two row-bit read-modify-writes from acq_rel to release, argued from the field comment (every reader runs after its writers were joined). No thread-sanitizer run checks it. Reviewers decide.

PR4' is separable into the tail block with its conversion and the hardware-attention policy. The deb preset flip and the benchmark rows are PR 4959's own commits below the merge, so their split is PR 4959's decision.

Reduced, not removed: PR3' keeps two is_main branches, the name store_k_block, the parameter c and FULL_BLOCK_0XFFFF in the tensor header. PR4' keeps store_block's lane mask for the bit-for-bit test and the hetero plugin's bool template parameters.
